decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans numbered 2360/8 PE 1, /PE 2, /PGFP, /PFFP, /PRP submitted on 13th September 2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the north-eastern wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the north eastern elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Replacement of existing single storey rear extension with a new single storey rear extension.
